why: Two stamps coarsened to one tick cannot say which came first, so a press stamped at the arrival's own instant must count as before it (issue #919). Browsers coarsen event and performance clocks to the same resolution, so a keydown that triggers an arrival within one tick would otherwise hand its keypress to the new primary.
killedBy: createCarriedConfirmGuard (issue #919) counts a press stamped at the arrival's own instant as before it
